I have sensitive skin with rosacea, and this routine has definitely helped, along with a metronidazole gel Rx. I use the cleanser twice a day, the pore perfector nightly, and the salicylic acid cream every other night. After 3 months, I have had no new pimples for over a week, and the rosacea is under control (but not gone, which I didn't expect.) Some of my old bumps and red scars have not fully disappeared, but I am hopeful that after another 3 months, they might go away or fade. Bottom line, my skin tolerated these 3 products very well; they definitely did not make my problems worse.
